seasonRead.headline: 2017–18: Puck pressure and creation collapse into one broad job
paragraphs: Puck-Pressure Two-Way Creator absorbs an extraordinary share of the named profile map. That should be read as label compression, not a claim that four out of five forwards played identical hockey; takeaways, chance share and continuation simply traveled together often enough to crowd the other labels.

High-Touch Puck Mover provides the sharper contrast: more frequent puck responsibility, special-situation creation and failed touches. The distinction is less who works and who creates than how much of the offense runs through one player.

seasonRead.headline: 2017–18: The broad label hides a sharper blue-line contrast
paragraphs: Defensive Role Defenseman contains several very different kinds of defender, so its headline share should not be treated as one uniform stay-at-home identity or one repeatable tactical assignment.

The cleaner hockey comparison sits underneath it: Shot-Blocking Defensive Defenseman carries the block-heavy, low-advancement footprint, while Play-Driving Puck-Moving Defenseman carries the puck-moving one. Those are the roles a pairing decision can actually balance.
